title: Research: bound completed errors in the zero-retention QQ16 decoder
body:
## Summary

```diff
 PR2707's unchanged 3,823-event zero-retention QQ16 word
- no word-specific completed-instruction error allowance
+ all-cut error <= B*2919388*u/(1-199144*u)
+ u <= 2^(-b-22) suffices for error < B*2^-b
+ borrowed X/Y remain exactly unchanged, with no writes
```

Adds only `research/qq16-zero-retention-defects/`: a conditional norm proof, independently implemented forward/adjoint checker, complete rational receipt, exact source snapshots and registered replay. The norm is maximum-per-owner payload Hilbert norm at every positive common tensor depth, with positive entry bound B. Exact owned CLEARs and destination-local completed ADD/line/map defect contracts are explicit premises.

This takes PR2707's precision handoff. Its ideal native semantics and invoice are inherited, not recertified. Twenty-two is minimal only for this majorant's uniform sufficient test, not a physical precision minimum. No new κ, supplier or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- Before, PR2707 explicitly leaves this changed word's rounded precision open. PR2628/2670/2692 address a different retained-record word; their numbers do not transfer.
- After, all 3,816 changed-field cuts and 22,896 rational weights agree with independent reverse prefix propagation. Exact maxima are P=32368, J=2919388, K=199144. A separate read-only internal mathematical/spec review found no actionable defect. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.
- CPython 3.12.15, Linux/WSL2: registered normal/optimized replay and eleven behavioral test groups pass. Controls cover noncommuting isometries, erased real transients, dirty state, borrowed writes, scratch cleanup, capacity, missing defect loads, guard failure and actual source/typed-receipt corruption. A Git-free relocated replay is read-only. All 69 research-workflow tests, selected baseline bindings, Ruff lint/format and whitespace checks pass.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-zero-retention-defects
```

Task `joint-query-controller`, refined scope, priority revision 5; draw `51c16552561ea1c8d73916172afb54b6`. Scientific base `78ceed4139bc61be797f6d38f21a03d972bb3290`; exact dependency PR2707 `efa51a6c7ffec6edd556a98deedfe9deeba65809`. Before submission, canonical main refreshed to `5c2ad4fcded5fe44b12d192150bd0ab6af3cc3f3`: guidance, selected record, runner and consumed dependency unchanged. Frozen source pins are intentionally retained. Live overlap covered 755 open PRs and 1,358 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings, with targeted head inspection.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727). Credit ywz65/PR2707 and PR2540, Arham Tahir/PR2681, Ali Romman and the retained QQ16/native lineage, and the earlier completed-defect analyses. Source notices and Apache-2.0 terms are retained.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one opt-in research package. No production verifier, selected result or frozen predecessor changes.

Physical component rounding, child internals, entry/F0/B1 precision, map/wrapper/movement/hosting costs, output consumption and full supplier admission remain open. No selected cold replay or hosted-CI pass is claimed. The package's structured next questions identify a physical completed-instruction implementation and a complete caller invoice as the next obligations.
